description: Use for 'who should I target from my account list?' or 'are these companies showing buying signals?'. Rank your tracked accounts by their saved open opportunities relevant to your offering (and by Intakra's account score for fit, timing and reach, 0 to 100, when it is on for your workspace), with dated proof, links and a rough time frame. Optional domains restrict the list. Returns missing accounts and accounts without eligible saved signals. Public events can suggest a reason to investigate; they do not confirm need, budget or purchase intent. This does not run fresh research or contact anyone.

domains.description: Optional company domains to check against your tracked list, up to 200. Omit to use your tracked accounts.
